verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no official documentation of per-channel, keyword, or scheduled notification tuning controls, and community evidence directly contradicts the story: 'MS have not implemented muting as a feature... Unavoidable alerts that any idiot on any channel can annoy people with' and 'Notifications in channels are easy to miss.' No vendor claim exists to create a 'disputed' case—just an unsupported/failed capability.
